parsed.name: ai_power_global
parsed.strategy: Bet that the AI capex bottleneck is physical, not narrative: power generation and grid gear (GEV, VRT, NVT), the memory and foundry layer that capex actually buys (MU, TSM, ASML), and the large-cap pharma names with the strongest analyst revision breadth and dated Q4 catalysts (MRK, AMGN, ARGX, WST). CCJ adds uranium supply. Software and OKTA/SNOW/CRWD are the revision-breadth sleeve. I would be wrong if hyperscaler capex pauses (killing GEV/VRT/NVT/MU together), if the Oct 10 MRK or Nov 30 VRTX-type PDUFAs draw CRLs, or if the revision-breadth names mean-revert after their run.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs, via dated AI-power, memory and pharma catalysts.

strategy.brief: AI power bottleneck, worldwide: power generation, grid, cooling, transformers, turbines and the memory that AI capex buys. Prefer names with a dated observable (backlog, orders, earnings) in the window. Personal book: long only, 6-month horizon (126 sessions), no per-name cap, declare cash explicitly (0 is a declaration), graded net of costs against SPY.
